data.narrative:
Zephyr Fusion is a pre-seed nuclear energy company founded by two plasma physicists with 15+ and 20+ years of experience respectively, including tenures at Lawrence Livermore National Lab and Oak Ridge National Lab. The company has raised $500K to date. The broader nuclear energy sector includes 3 public comparables (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 7 private peers, including Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy.

Given the absence of a sufficient cohort of same-stage or adjacent-stage private nuclear companies (fewer than 3 datapoints meeting narrow criteria), peer-median analysis is not applicable. Stage-progression methodology is the primary triangulation method available. Using the $500K total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a standard 2.5x multiplier for Pre-Seed to next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $1.25M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.06M to $1.44M, with a median of $1.25M. This range reflects early-stage capital deployment and standard step-up expectations but lacks validation from peer transaction multiples in the narrow nuclear energy pre-seed cohort. Key uncertainties include the absence of comparable pre-seed transactions in the sector (limiting cross-validation) and the degree to which founder pedigree and technical IP justify movement above or below the stage-median. Additional diligence on intellectual property scope and development timelines would be necessary to refine this estimate.
